Admins can now create teams from a new Teams page at `/app/teams`. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of it is checked.

- **API:** `features/teams/api/create-team.ts` sends `POST /teams` with a name and a description. It has a zod schema, and the input type is inferred from that schema. After a save it refreshes the teams list. It also shows the "Team Created" success notification, inside the mutation hook, as your project notes require.
- **Mock API:** `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts` has a new POST handler. It checks the user is logged in and an admin, creates the team and persists it.
- **Page:** `/app/teams` is registered in the router and in `paths`. The page shows an admin-only table of name, description and created date, with a Create Team button that opens the form drawer. The new files are `teams-list.tsx` and `create-team.tsx` under `features/teams/components`, and `app/routes/app/teams.tsx`.
- **Navigation:** the dashboard sidebar shows a "Teams" link only to admins, next to "Users".

The new handler catches errors as `unknown` rather than `any`, so it differs slightly from the older handlers.
